title: Luxembourg City, Luxembourg Canton — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Luxembourg City, Luxembourg Canton: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Luxembourg City is a city in Luxembourg Canton with a population of 132,780. The wealthy capital of the Grand Duchy, home to EU institutions, a thriving financial sector, and a UNESCO-listed old town perched on dramatic cliffs. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
